key_decisions.decision: Keep Asaph as written despite the related Ebiasaph form elsewhere.
Preserve the ambiguous his-relative attachment without inventing a parent for the final two.
Preserve the explicit departure from firstborn precedence.
Keep Shuppim despite the difficult text and preserve the gate and road.
Keep the uncertain architectural term and the four-plus-two placement.
Retain Ahijah as a name while noting the ancient alternative their relatives.
Follow Shelomith’s read form and preserve the consecutive descent formula.
Retain the Shelomoth form here and every donor category.
